Artist: Beck · Title: Nausea · Album: Nausea · Year: 2006 · Genre: Alternative Rock · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2000's/Beck - Nausea.mp4
It was released as the first single from his 2006 album The Information.

The song appears in the 2010 film Repo Men.
The Information is the tenth studio album by American musician Beck, released on October 3, 2006 by Interscope Records.
